subject: dsa
title: Valid Sudoku
summary: A board is valid only if no row, column, or 3x3 box repeats a digit. Scan each unit and remember the digits seen; a repeat means the board is invalid.
problem: A Sudoku board is valid only if no row, no column, and no 3x3 box repeats a digit from 1 to 9. This lesson shows the no-repeat check on a single 3x3 box; the same check runs on every row, column, and box.

steps.caption: A board is valid only if no row, column, or 3x3 box repeats a digit. Here is one box; the same check runs on every unit.
Scan the box and note the 5 in the top-left corner.
Another 5 appears in the bottom-right. Two 5s in one box, so this box is invalid.
Done. A repeat in any row, column, or box makes the whole board invalid.
